historical_record.description: An existing three-story-over-basement residential building stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for height in excess of 40 feet in an "R" District, in conjunction with the addition of a new floor containing two dwelling units to an existing three-story-over-basement residential building.
